## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `7c80463a861ef0cdb38dadc39b6df56008d76d7a`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/agents/os-dev.md, .claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/coordinator.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/decision-analysis.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/dispatch-runbook.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/director.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/mobile.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/objectstack.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-lifecycle.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/state-machine.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/triage-duties.md, docs/NORTH-STAR.md + scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/close-cards.mjs, scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs
Security-touching: no
No changed hunk teaches permission, sharing, credential, token, authentication or other security behaviour. The diff is fleet rule text, two North Star grading passages and report-only patrol rows; none of the four cards carries `security`.

### ① Derived judgments

- Read for this record: cards #35259, #35298, #35230 and #35246 with every comment; the PR body, its 21-file list and the net diff from the merge base `0967cbe6a2` (+1165, -779); the 56 check-runs on the head. The seat's own comment on the PR was not used, and nothing was built, run or re-run.
- Published surface: none. No package `files[]` entry, no schema, no product accept-set and no public API is in the diff. Every changed path is `.claude/**`, `scripts/pm/**` or `docs/NORTH-STAR.md`.
- Fleet label vocabulary narrows by one: `pm:blocking` leaves `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh`, the residue set `PM_RESIDUE_LABELS`, the patrol's comment gate and the H67 read order, and H14 and H15 go with their only helper. At the head the string survives only in the patrol's retirement pins and the vocabulary script's retirement note, and no removed export has a surviving reader. Right, per card #35259 item 5 and card #35246.
- The blocking relation has one source at the head, the line-start `Blocked-by:` line. No rule line and no script reads a label for it. H67's read order is pinned equal to `GRADE_LADDER`, so the rank a dispatching seat reads and the rank a blocker inherits are one spelling.
- The patrol gains five rows, H77 to H81 (bands stall, state, state, stall, stall). All five are report-only; none writes a label, a grade or a comment. `FAMILY_LEDGER_ROW_CAP` moves 64 to 72 to hold them. H19's sentence is extended to name the release candidate. Right.
- The decision path changes owner: the seat-tier fallback and its `Analysis-tier:` line are gone (no hit anywhere at the head, and no script read it), the `AskUserQuestion` accelerator lines are gone, and every request for the maintainer's decision now passes a `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` decision thread at effort `xhigh`. This is card #35259's item 11 (scope comments 6998694957 and 6999656302), stated in `SKILL.md`, `decision-analysis.md`, `filing-gate.md`, `os-dev.md`, `coordinator.md` and `lanes/director.md`.
- The maintainer brief changes shape from six lines to four in both forms. No hit remains at the head for the old labels (「六行」, 「需要你做的」, 「四通道」), no script counts brief lines, and the patrol keys on the heading alone, which is unchanged.
- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` changes on lines 139 and 165 only. Line 139 adds the type sentences (slowness is a Bug, refactor and operations work is a Task, the experience split, an epic or tracking card takes no type, a bug found during development is typed card by card) and widens the Feature exception from "blocks another repository's p1" to "blocks a p1". Line 165 reverses a sentence: on `main` the grade "is not inherited up the chain", with one exception for a card blocking another repository's p1; at the head a blocker takes the highest grade among its own and the open cards it blocks, in this repository or another, a hand-set grade is not moved and is reported, and no label is typed for the relation. These are grading-rule changes on a Tier H surface, each traced to the maintainer's word (card #35259 item 3 and scope comments 6998207239 and 6998230415); the whole PR is his to approve by hand.
- Ratchet: the five moved ceilings equal the landed line counts (state-machine 50, decision-analysis 62, filing-gate 87, execution-duties 189, os-dev 410), the other ten skill files in the diff are edited in place at their ceilings, headroom zero.
- Check-runs on the head: 56 in all, 34 success, 22 skipped, none red and none pending. Green among them: Governed Surface Queue Guard, Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · scoped · tooling self-tests, TypeScript Type Check, Test Core and its shards, Dogfood Regression Gate, Live half-state sweep, PR-body guards, Check Documentation Links. Check Changeset is skipped under `skip-changeset`, as it should be.

### ② Semver level

- `skip-changeset` matches what the diff publishes, which is nothing: `.claude/**`, `scripts/pm/**` and `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` ship in no package. No bump is owed.
- The PR body's `Clause-②: no` holds: no published schema, protocol, public API or accept-set moves. `Metadata-protocol: none` holds.

### ③ Boundary flags

Reading questions (the four `open_questions` of dev report 7002992514, and the fourth reading listed in the PR body):

- Q1, the Chinese channels. The dev's reading A holds: three Chinese channels (brief, round report, ruling quotes), the four-axis analysis written in English in the analysis section, new records only. It is the card's own text, not an inference: card #35298 moves "the four axes, the 四棱 block, the self-check line" to "the English part" and names "the Chinese four-channel wording" under Where. It needs no separate ruling; it does retire an earlier habit (analysis in Chinese), so the seat's approval brief should say so in one line and the maintainer sees it when he approves. The reading is applied incompletely in the tree: see S1.
- Q2, the review comment's id and the reviewed head on the 「要你做什么」 line (`SKILL.md:209`). Keep them, as the dev did. The card's ⛔ list (code names, file paths, commands, ruling letters, bare card numbers) does not name them, and they are the audit pin of the governed hand-off. Keeping needs nobody's word. Moving them off the line would change the hand-off contract and needs the maintainer's word.
- Q3, the seat's opinion line after the four. Keep it. The card bounds the brief at four lines and is silent on the seat's line, the old shape was "six lines plus the seat's opinion", and the patrol rows that read the brief key on the heading. Keeping needs nobody's word; only the maintainer can drop it.
- Q4, record cards and `eval-run`. Two parts. Type and grade: already ruled, `docs/NORTH-STAR.md:139` says a record card takes no type and no grade, and the dev was right to leave `checklist-test/SKILL.md:146-148` alone. Area: the North Star is silent for record cards; the exemption for `qa-run` lives in merged skill and script text (`triage-duties.md:18`, the sweep's exclusion list), and `eval-run` is in neither. Whether record cards stay outside the area rule, and whether `eval-run` joins the exclusion, changes a pinned rule sentence and a script outside this fence. NEEDS THE MAINTAINER'S WORD. Not this PR's to settle, and the dev rightly did not edit it.
- Fifth reading, the last line 「无」 on a surface that is not governed. Holds: the card writes "exactly one thing, or 「无」" and `os-dev.md:287` says 「末行恰一件事或「无」」. Needs nobody's word.

Escalations:

- E1, `Fixes #35230` cannot be judged from the tree. The card's Done-when is "No passage in the reports' section 2 still contradicts the merged rules, or each remaining one names why it stays." The section 2 lists are in the review reports, which sit in another project's files: not in the tree, not on the card, and reachable neither by the dev (who says so) nor by this review. What the tree shows is nine in-place edits, each of which I hold correct against the merged rule text, and eleven groups read and left with a reason each. Whether that covers section 2 is unknowable here. Before the closing line stands, either the seat that holds the reports (seat 1, which filed the card) reconciles the section 2 lists against those nine edits and eleven groups in a comment on the card, or the closing line is demoted to a plain reference (a PR-body edit, head unmoved) and the card stays open for the remainder.
- E2, Q4 above: the area rule for record cards and `eval-run` in the sweep's exclusion. The maintainer's word.
- E3, a follow-up card is owed for `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs` (outside the diff): its type row does not exempt `pm:epic`, which this PR's rule text now leaves without a type. See N5. It can ride the same card as E2's script change once that is ruled.

Closing lines:

- `Fixes #35259`: judged from the tree and met. Items 1 to 4, 7, 9 and 10 are in `state-machine.md` and the four state rows of `SKILL.md`; item 5 is out of the vocabulary script and every reader; items 6 and 8 are in `filing-gate.md:23-24` and `os-dev.md:363`; item 11 is in the six files named in ①; the six conditions are reported by H4, H77, H19, H78, H79, H80 and H81 with a firing case and a control each; no card number or dated quote is in the skill text. Item 2's "releases them" is met by the pair the charter allows: H19 names the candidate and the daily reconciliation fire acts (`state-machine.md:33`, `triage-duties.md:38`). The patrol itself stays report-only; accepted.
- `Fixes #35246`: judged from the tree and met. H14 and H15 are gone, H67 reads the grade ladder alone, and a self-test pins a p1 card ahead of a card carrying only the retired label.
- `Fixes #35298`: met on its first three Done-when bullets. Its fourth ("its own PR after #35259's PR merges") is not met by design: the claim comments 7000277771 and 7000835776 fold the cards into one PR on the maintainer's quoted word (「那你还是直接派发吧」, 「为什么不能合并派发」). Accepted, and in front of him at approval.

Other dev flags:

- Commits are not one per card: accepted. The branch cannot be force-pushed; the per-card boundaries are named, and the net diff is what is reviewed.
- Model-free commit trailers against the dispatch's ask: correct, the repository rule wins.
- PR-body tail and the first-line attribution comment: body-only matters, the seat's to rewrite if it wants the other form; PR-body guards is green. The one model name in the body sits inside the maintainer's ruling quoted as written; no added line in the tree names a model.
- Three merges of `main`, the third forced by a ceiling-row conflict: the ceilings at the head equal the landed counts.
- `test:repo` left to CI, and CI read once before it finished: Test Core and its shards are green on the head and nothing is pending now.
- H78 does not detect a hand-set grade: accepted as a design limit (the per-card events read is not bought); the wording of the read it names is S2.
- H78 to H80 read this repository's edges only: N6. H81 counts from the card's creation: accepted, the row states the direction of the error and it can only over-report.
- Leftover `pm:blocking` labels on cards, the label object, and the patrol copies in the sibling repositories that still carry H14 and H15: outside the fence, separate seat acts.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` red: not re-run here. The dev reads it as `main`'s own and the gate is off per-PR CI; nothing in this diff touches what it reads.

SQL push-down: not applicable. The diff adds no query, no id materialisation and no in-app join; the patrol rows are pure functions over listings the sweep already holds.

### ④ Design judgment

No must-fix.

S1 (should-fix) — `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md:241` still tells the reader to post the decision analysis in Chinese (「分析发评论,中文」), while lines 106 and 107 of the same file, rewritten by this diff, keep Chinese for three channels only (「中文只留三通道(维护者速读、轮报、裁决引文)」) and say 「四维分析写英文、归分析段」; `references/decision-analysis.md:17` says the same (「其下英文分析段给评审与 agent」). Line 241 is the decision path's own line, so a seat that lands on it writes the analysis in the language the channel rule has just retired. It is the only leftover: a search of the head for 「中文」 across the fleet skills finds no other line that puts analysis text in Chinese. Fix in place (the file sits at its 329-line ceiling): the brief is the Chinese part, the analysis is English.

S2 (should-fix) — `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs`, H78 (`h78BlockerBelowBlockedGrade`: the row text at lines 4188 to 4191 and the doc comment above it). The row decides whose grade it is by the last `labeled` event alone: "Written through a GitHub App or by a bot actor, it is the fleet's — triage raises it and leaves one comment." The contract it restates is `references/filing-gate.md:37-38`, and line 38 says the opposite for one named case: 「代维护者落的级:同笔评论行首 `Ruling-ref: priority:pN` 引原话才算人定;⛔ 不凭 bot 判车队。」 A grade the fleet wrote on the maintainer's word is bot-written by construction (the grades on this PR's own cards are that case), and for it the row tells triage to raise a grade that `references/state-machine.md:35` and `docs/NORTH-STAR.md:165` give to the maintainer (「人定的级 ⛔ 不动,由扫描报维护者」). The doc comment's claim that the sentence "names the read and BOTH outcomes" and "is correct whichever the grade turns out to be" does not hold for this third outcome. The damage is bounded: `scripts/pm/label-write.mjs` (outside the diff, read only) refuses the write when the fleet's `Ruling-ref:` fold sits beside the event, so no hand-set grade moves through the fleet's own door. What is lost is the routing: the row names the wrong owner, and reporting to the maintainer is not what it tells triage to do. Fix: one clause in the row and its doc comment (a fleet-written grade whose same-stroke comment opens `Ruling-ref: priority:pN` is hand-set too), and one self-test case pinning it.

Nits (no effect on correctness or the contract; none asks for a commit on this head):

- N1 (nit) — `references/decision-analysis.md:8` still reads 「卡面分析只一层 = 立卡席六项 + 四棱」, naming the filing seat as the author of the analysis layer, beside line 44, which gives the analysis and the brief to the decision thread with 「⛔ 无席位档退路」. Readable as "one layer, whoever writes it"; a later wording pass can settle it.
- N2 (nit) — `references/lanes/director.md:23` introduces 「决策线程」 one line above the unchanged 「⛔ 无裁决线程、代裁、置信门」. They are different things (a thread that analyses and talks with the maintainer; a thread that would rule for him), but the near-homonym on adjacent lines invites a misread.
- N3 (nit) — `SKILL.md:181` keeps 「队列与级别的第三例外」 after line 180 dropped 级别 from the rule whose exceptions it counts.
- N4 (nit) — `GRADELESS_CARD_LABELS` names the anchor and the seat post but not record cards (`qa-run`, `eval-run`), which `docs/NORTH-STAR.md:139` also leaves without a grade. A record card named in a `Blocked-by:` line would draw a false H78 row. Rare, and report-only.
- N5 (nit) — a rule ahead of its instrument. `docs/NORTH-STAR.md:139`, `filing-gate.md:61` and `triage-duties.md:66` now say a `pm:epic` card carries no type, while `scripts/pm/first-touch-sweep.mjs` on `main` (outside the diff, read only) says "no label excuses a type" and exempts `tracking` but not `pm:epic` on its type row. Once this lands, the daily sweep lists every type-less epic card, and `triage-duties.md:67` tells triage to fill what the sweep lists. Follow-up card owed (E3).
- N6 (nit) — H78, H79 and H80 read this repository's edges only, while the rule says 「同仓跨仓同」. The limit is stated on every row (unread, not absent) and follows from the one-repository token. Accepted; the cross-repository half stays a hand check.
- N7 (nit) — the blocker rule as written (`docs/NORTH-STAR.md:165`) lets the blocker of a p0 card take p0, beside line 167's "p0 is time, not severity, and only these". Probably intended, but it is the maintainer's sentence to confirm when he reads line 165.
- N8 (nit) — `SKILL.md:281` and `decision-analysis.md:45` route every request through the coordinator; no line names the route for a seat running outside a project thread (a scheduled fire). Such a reader stops and waits, which is the safe direction.
- N9 (nit) — `state-machine.md:22` gives one default for both directions (「(或反之)⇒ 默认被挡卡随之入 hold」), which cannot apply when the blocked card is the one already on hold. H79's reverse row says so and names no default; the script is the more careful of the two.
- N10 (nit) — PR body only: the acceptance notes say the body does not claim card #35246 and count three cards, while the body opens with a closing line for #35246 (claimed by comment 7003160401). A body edit, head unmoved.

Every `hits` file, against the cards it is accepted on and the rule text on `main`:

- `docs/NORTH-STAR.md` — lines 139 and 165 only, each sentence traceable to scope comments 6998207239 and 6998230415 on card #35259. The record-card sentence is kept; the two cross-references ("unless it blocks a p1, below", "or higher by the blocker rule below") point at the rewritten line 165. Holds; N7 for the maintainer's read.
- `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md` — the four state rows (116 to 119) carry items 1, 2, 4, 7 and 10; the `pm:blocking` row is gone; 144 and 145 say the relation is read from the lines and a blocker takes the top grade; 198 to 209 state the four-line brief plus the seat's opinion; 230, 281, 282 and 286 state item 11. Holds, except S1 on line 241; N3.
- `references/state-machine.md` — line 22 (holds match), 27 (the line is the only source; a target is an open card or an unmerged PR), 33 to 35 (release by the daily scan, the scan's other reports, the blocker's grade), 44 to 46 (the maintainer's own card, the decision box and the three-day listing). Agrees with the card's items and with the patrol rows one for one. Holds; N9.
- `references/filing-gate.md` — 18 (four-line brief on a decision card), 22 to 24 (no card for a problem in an unmerged feature; same-topic fleet cards block only on the same file; split the waiting part), 43 (decision box through the decision thread), 61 (type per card), 69 (the blocker's grade). Lines 36 to 38, the hand-set rule, are untouched and are what S2 is measured against. Holds.
- `references/decision-analysis.md` — 17 to 27 give the decision brief's four lines, the ⛔ list, what stays in the English section and the worked example without its card number; 44 and 45 give authorship to the decision thread at `xhigh`, `max` only when the maintainer names it. Matches card #35298 and scope comment 6999656302. Holds; N1.
- `references/triage-duties.md` — 38 (the daily fire reads the blocking and decision rows and acts under `state-machine.md`), 49 (decision brief), 66 (type per card). The two H14 lines are gone. The pinned exclusion sentence on line 18 is untouched. Holds; N5.
- `references/coordinator.md` — line 39: the coordinator opens the ceiling-tier decision thread at `xhigh` with the dev report attached. Agrees with `decision-analysis.md:45`. Holds.
- `references/lanes/director.md` — line 23: an in-project `needs_decision` goes to the decision box, the claim is released, the coordinator opens the thread, the ruling is recorded on the card. Holds; N2.
- `references/dispatch-runbook.md` — 172 (a derived sub-issue is graded by the table, not inherited) and 175 (the blocker's grade). Both agree with the merged grading rule. Holds.
- `references/execution-duties.md` — line 41 (graded by the table) and the removed `pm:blocking` sweep line. Holds.
- `references/seat-lifecycle.md` line 64 and `references/seat-post-protocol.md` lines 71 and 87 — only the maintainer opens a `pm:epic` exception; an accepted release issue returns to the grade the table gives. Agree with the merged rule that only the maintainer opens sub-epics. Hold.
- `references/lanes/mobile.md` line 43 and `references/lanes/objectstack.md` line 11 — the brief's renamed last line, and the dropped H14 clause. Hold.
- `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` — 42 (labels belong to the filing seat), 284 to 291 (the PR brief: four fixed lines, the ⛔ list, the first-read files and the two-minute check kept in the English part), 358 (a dev never asks the maintainer directly), 363 (a `blocked` report names the part that can go first). Matches cards #35298 and #35259 items 8 and 11. Holds.
- `.claude/skills/checklist-test/SKILL.md` — 160 and 182: a card filed out of a run carries its area, type and grade at filing. The record card's own passage is rightly untouched (Q4). Holds.

Every implementing file, against the contract sentence by sentence:

- `scripts/pm/check-half-states.mjs` — H77 fires on a `pm:blocked` card whose line names no open card and no unmerged PR, and stands down where H4 (no line) or H19 (all closed, release candidate) already speaks, so one card draws one row. H78 compares in the right direction, reports an ungraded blocker, stays silent on a gradeless kind and ignores a dependent whose grade cannot be read; its wording is S2. H79 reports both directions and states the default only where the rule has one. H80 groups mutual blocks and cycles by strongly connected component (the iterative search is correct on a pair, a ring and a ring with a tail) and puts one row on the lowest-numbered card. H81 shares `governingRuledRecord` with H73, so a card is one row or the other and never both; the threshold is 3 days as the rule says. The battery carries a firing case and a silencing control for each row; the tooling self-test job is green on the head. Agrees with the contract except S2; N4, N6.
- `scripts/pm/ensure-pm-labels.sh` — the `pm:blocking` row is removed and a retirement note says why the label object is left alone. Agrees with item 5.
- `scripts/pm/close-cards.mjs` — two self-test cases stop using the retired label as residue; no behaviour change beyond the shared residue set. Agrees.
- `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` — the TRIAGE sample carries a four-line brief and an English options table, and its pin is extended. Agrees with card #35298.
- `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` — ceiling rows and their comments only; each equals the landed count. Agrees.

Tried to break it, and it held: a block whose only target is a PR closed unmerged (H77, not H19); a blocker with no grade under a p1 dependent (H78 fires and names p1); a three-card ring sharing a member with a mutual pair (one row, one group); a decision card that re-entered the box naming its earlier ruling (H81, not H73); any surviving reader of the removed exports, the retired label or the six-line brief labels (none at the head); any added line naming a model, a card number or a dated quote in skill text (none).
